user.title: Connect to Heliotherm heat pump
user.description: Enter the address of the serial-to-Ethernet converter connected to the heat pump's -X26 Modem COM port.

data_description.host: IP address of the Waveshare (or similar) RS232-to-Ethernet converter.
data_description.port: TCP Server port configured on the converter.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the converter. Check the IP address, port, and that the converter is powered and on the network.
error.invalid_response: Connected, but the heat pump did not respond correctly. Check that the converter is set to 19200 baud, 8N1, RTS/CTS flow control, and transparent TCP Server mode.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read live measurements. The serial link runs at 19200 baud, so values below 60 seconds may not complete in time.
data_description.sp_interval: Configuration values change rarely. Reading them on every cycle wastes bus time.
